faq.sectionLabel: What's the risk? What are we not telling you?
faq.title: Honest answers to hard questions
faq.subtitle: We know you're looking at this carefully. Here's what we'd want to know if we were you.

items.question: What happens to my data? Can you see it?
items.answer: Your data is locked down — both when it moves and when it's stored. We never look at your data unless you ask us to help fix something. We never use your data to train our AI. Big companies can run Vuen on their own servers so nothing ever leaves their building. We're SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant.

items.question: What if the AI gives me a wrong answer?
items.answer: Every chart shows you the exact steps Vuen took to get the answer, so you can check it yourself. When Vuen isn't sure, it tells you — it won't just guess. We also show how many rows and which data sources are behind every chart so you can double-check fast. That said, always verify big decisions yourself, just like you would with any tool.

items.question: Will this actually work with my messy data?
items.answer: Yes. Vuen handles mismatched column names, missing values, and mixed formats. If something is unclear, it asks you instead of guessing. We've tested with real data from hundreds of companies — the messy kind, not the clean demo kind.

items.question: What are the real limits?
items.answer: Vuen works best with tables, spreadsheets, and databases. It's not built for things like raw text files or images. The free plan gives you 40 questions a month — enough to try it, but you'll want Pro for daily use. Really complex questions that pull from 10+ tables at once can take 3-5 seconds instead of under one.

items.question: What if I want to cancel?
items.answer: Cancel anytime from your settings. No phone calls, no one trying to talk you out of it, no hoops. Your data is deleted within 30 days, or right away if you ask. We'll even help you export everything first.

items.question: Why should I trust a startup over Tableau or Power BI?
items.answer: You probably shouldn't replace them — yet. Try Vuen alongside your current tools for free. Most of our customers didn't switch right away. They started using Vuen for quick answers in meetings, and slowly noticed their team stopped opening the old dashboards. We're backed by Google for Startups and NVIDIA Inception, and we're SOC 2 certified.

transformation.before2: You pay for Tableau, Power BI, or Looker, but most of the company never opens them. They take screenshots, paste into slides, or bug the one person who knows the tool.
transformation.before3: Follow-up questions stop everything. "What about by region? By channel?" means 10 more clicks and a 5-minute pause while everyone checks their phones.
transformation.before4: You feel underprepared in board meetings because the right number is always one more question away.
transformation.after1: You ask "How many customers did we lose this month?" and the answer shows up on screen before you finish talking. Everyone stays focused. You decide now.
transformation.after2: Your whole team — marketing, operations, finance, the CEO — asks questions and gets answers. No more waiting on the one person who knows the tools. Just talk.
transformation.after3: You go from the big picture to the details without losing anyone. "Show by region... now by product... now vs last year" — each answer in under a second.
transformation.after4: You walk into every meeting as the most prepared person in the room. Not because you spent hours getting ready, but because you can answer any question on the spot.
transformation.closingBefore: You don't just get a better tool.
transformation.closingAfter: You become the person who always has the answer.
